title: Thoughts are missing from api_response logs
body:
### What happened?

The model's thoughts used to be logged as part of the _response_text_ , but they have been missing now. 

I did tests in different branches. For each branch, I ran the gemini cli in non-interactive mode and asked it to solve a task from swebench lite.  For each branch, I tested 20 tasks. 

For the branch **release/v0.1.18**, we still can see the thoughts present in the api response  for all the 20 noninteractive runs to solve the task (check example [here](https://gist.github.com/silviojr/c43eb145ed68ab35be7acbb9b565ad2d))  . Just look for the part where thought equals true (e.g. : \"thought\":true). 

For the main branch, the thoughts are not present in none of the 20 runs. Please check example [here](https://gist.github.com/silviojr/8908888d1f24d7fe8821d9a7ed6d2295). 



### What did you expect to happen?

I expected to see the thoughts present in the api response. This should be included, since the option is turned on: https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/blob/653267a64f8cd3b270176ec90b37a34383bf5bf2/packages/core/src/core/client.ts#L251 

The telemetry should log the raw response so we can study the agent's trajectory to improve its behavior. 


### Client information

<details>

I am running this using a command like: 

```
$> echo ' ' | npx --cache {temp_cache_dir} https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli#{branch} --debug -y --telemetry --telemetry-otlp-endpoint=no --telemetry-target=local --telemetry-outfile={absolute_file_path} --sandbox=false --prompt {shlex.quote(prompt)}
```

</details>

### Login information

Using vertex

### Anything else we need to know?

_No response_

linked_prs.title: Log all parts of a streaming response
linked_prs.body:
## TLDR

It seems that this behavior changed with: https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/commit/60bde58f29815edba365daf04c07080e8d1b24d8

Notice that with this change, we are only logging the last response of the stream of responses (those were called **chunks**  and aggregated before being logged in chatGemini.ts). 

Having those full logs help us debug what is going within the agent's trajectory. 

## Dive Deeper

<!-- more thoughts and in-depth discussion here -->

## Reviewer Test Plan

Run gcli and enable telemetry. An easy way to test is logging the telemetry to files: 

```
 npm start -- --debug -y --telemetry --telemetry-otlp-endpoint=no --telemetry-target=local --telemetry-outfile=/tmp/cli_logs.txt --sandbox=false
```

Then examine the file created (in this case, /tmp/cli_logs.txt). In my case I see multiple content-parts that are part of the respone, such as "thought", "text" and function calls.
